instruction: Could you set up a global keyboard shortcut for adjusting the volume, so it works even when another window is focused?

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'global-key-vol-up', default: '' } ] }); return data[0]; }
